Chapter 1024: 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2

Chapter 1024: Chapter 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2

However, upon this observation, the minds of countless twelve-tier beings could not help but shudder.

The inner cosmos of twelve-tier lives operates under rules entirely determined by themselves.

Simply put,

the cosmos within twelve-tier beings can only function based on the rules they have comprehended.

But at this moment, in the field of vision of all twelve-tier beings, the rules operating within the surrounding spacetime could almost be described as vast as an ocean of smoke, with each rule’s depth so unfathomable that no twelve-tier being could aspire to reach it.

Especially the two foundational pillar rules of time and space, which swept grandly like celestial columns supporting the universe. Even these twelve-tier beings, before these two “celestial columns,” seemed like mere ants.

“The inner cosmos of the galaxy’s strongest entity?”

All twelve-tier beings felt their scalps tingle. They had never seen such an intricate interplay of rules within an inner cosmos. How many rules had been comprehended here?

Moreover, besides the infinite rules fueling its support, the twelve-tier beings faintly perceived that the fundamental essence of this inner cosmos was heavy and beyond comprehension.

Even they would find it challenging to traverse the void across great distances within this cosmos. In the Main Universe, a mere strike from a twelve-tier being could tear open a Permanent Spatial Rift.

But here?

Forget about a Permanent Spatial Rift; creating even a single spatial rift required considerable effort from twelve-tier beings.

“The inner cosmos of the galaxy’s strongest entity…”

A twelve-tier being’s throat felt dry. For some reason, they faintly sensed that this inner cosmos was even vaster than the boundless Main Universe.

…

Beyond their home cosmos.

Blood Dominator and Serpent Monarch, these two mighty sovereigns, stood dumbfounded watching the distant cosmos—more precisely, watching the towering giant stride toward the cosmos’s edge, undeterred by countless calamities blocking its way.

“What is this?” Blood Dominator trembled all over. The spectacle before them was simply unfathomable. Wasn’t it said that lifeforms within the cosmos could at most reach the peak of the Path Splitting Realm?

What was the meaning of this giant towering heaven and earth?

Blood Dominator couldn’t ascertain the towering giant’s level of power, but one thing was certain—they were far from being its opponent. Not even close.

“What should we do, My Sovereign?”

“What should we do now?”

Blood Dominator’s dozens of subordinates had originally been stationed in strategically arranged zones, simply waiting for the twelve-tier lifeforms within the cosmos to escape, to then intercept and suppress them.

This was something they had done many times before without much incident. Even in the worst-case scenario of encountering the rare peak Path Splitting Realm beings seen only once in thousands of Cosmic Eras, they had ample countermeasures.

Everyone was at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, and they, who had battled in the Chaos Void for years, possessed combat experience and lethal tactics far exceeding those of any peak Path Splitting Realm being within the cosmos—a perfect scenario.

But now?

That towering giant… they were supposed to make a move against such an existence?

The dozens of peak Path Splitting Realm subordinates trembled with dread, daring not even to entertain the thought of action against it, let alone act.

The towering giant’s sheer presence was too overwhelming. If not for Blood Dominator’s longstanding authority and prestige, these subordinates would have scattered and fled already.

“What should we do?”

Blood Dominator steadied himself and immediately transmitted an order: “Retreat, all of you, return to me.”

At this moment, Blood Dominator’s only thought was to stay far away from this place, far away from the towering giant.

“Understood.”

Dozens of subordinates, as if receiving a pardon, hurriedly gathered toward Blood Dominator.

On the other side.

Serpent Monarch also ordered his subordinates to retreat, while he himself hastened to maneuver Suspended Island into swift flight.

…

“The Calamity of Great Destruction consists of Fire Tribulation, Thunder Tribulation, Wind Tribulation, and Water Tribulation. These four calamities do not represent foundational rules; they embody the universe’s core forces.”

Lin Yuan casually stepped forward toward the universe’s edge. “But these calamities are rather ordinary.”

Over three hundred years, Lin Yuan had leveraged the endless resources continually delivered from Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent to cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique to the twelve-tier sovereign realm.

In terms of physical strength and vitality, Lin Yuan was already remarkably close to Chaos Venerable. Coupled with an inner cosmos comparable to that of a Chaos Venerable, numerous innate divine skills, and various techniques…

Not to mention the universe’s origin consciousness, which mastered power somewhat rigidly; even a true Chaos Venerable would struggle to obstruct Lin Yuan.

In an all-out battle, Lin Yuan might not be a match for a Chaos Venerable, but neither could they hold him down.

If Lin Yuan could step into the sovereign realm and achieve another qualitative leap in his essence of life, he might even suppress ordinary Chaos Venerables.

If he managed to cultivate the “Infinite Void” to the Second Layer, his comprehensive combat strength could approach that of a Chaos Great Saint.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s final step landed, entirely escaping the obstruction of the universe’s origin consciousness.

“Freedom.”

An inexplicable thought surfaced in Lin Yuan’s heart. Within the cosmos, protected by the universe, even when transforming into its explorer, there remained a sense of constraint.

Now that he had completely broken free from the cosmos, a sense of liberation surged within him.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan turned around, casting a glance at the nearby universe.

Because Lin Yuan had timed his departure precisely to maximize absorption of World-Breaking Origin Force, upon his arrival in the Chaos Void, the universe’s Great Destruction had reached its final stages, with vast starfields obliterated and collapsing.

“This universe likely requires significant time to open its next Cosmic Era.” Lin Yuan faintly sensed the weakening of the universe’s origin.

Having lost countless lives and powerful beings as its driving force, after the Great Destruction, the universe’s origin consciousness would enter prolonged slumber to accumulate sufficient energy for initiating a new Cosmic Era.
